prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1088; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the front end shows a crushed bumper cover, a cracked grille, and a bent radiator support, all of which line up with a low-speed frontal impact as described. The damage pattern is consistent across the bumper bar, headlamp mounts, and hood leading edge, with no sign of older repair work or unrelated wear in the affected areas. Labor hours and parts listed on the estimate are reasonable for this scope. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover and grille, straighten the radiator support, install new headlamp brackets, refinish the hood edge, and run a full post-repair scan. Invoices on file contain no duplicate line items.
